```{r}
source("07_add_light_treatment.R")

data_full <- readRDS('data_full.rds')

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    lighting %>%
      select(date, color, intensity),
    by = "date"
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    color = factor(color),
    site = factor(site),
    intensity = factor(intensity)
  )

```

```{r}
library(sf)

ref_point <- st_as_sf(
  data.frame(
    lon = -110.645134,
    lat = 43.904879
  ),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

sites_sf <- st_as_sf(
  sites,
  coords = c('lon', 'lat'),
  crs = 4326
)

sites_sf <- st_transform(sites_sf, 32612)
ref_point <- st_transform(ref_point, 32612)

sites_sf$dist_m <- as.numeric(
  st_distance(
    sites_sf,
    ref_point
  )
)

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    sites_sf,
    by = 'site'
  )

data_env %>%
  select(site, dist_m) %>%
  distinct()

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    dist_km = dist_m / 1000
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    dist_cat = case_when(
      dist_km < 1 ~ "Close",
      dist_km < 2.1 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Far"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

  simple_model1 <- glmmTMB(
    weighted_detections ~
      color * intensity +
      mean_phase +
      pct_nonforest +
      jd^2 +
      color * jd +
      dist_cat +
      (1|site),
    data = data_env,
    ziformula = ~1,
    family = nbinom2()
  )
  
summary(simple_model1)
```

```{r}
source("06_run_models.R")
models <- run_models(data_env)

AIC(models$m0,models$m1,models$m2, models$sm)

anova(models$m0,models$m1)
anova(models$m1,models$m2)
anova(models$m1, models$sm)

sim <- simulateResiduals(models$sm)

plot(sim)

testDispersion(sim)

testZeroInflation(sim)

summary(models$sm)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(x = dist_km,
           y = detections)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") + 
  labs(
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Detections"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(x = dist_cat,
           y = detections)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance Category",
    y = "Detections"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

pred <- ggpredict(
  simple_model1,
  terms = c("jd [all]", "color", "intensity")
)

ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  labs(
    x = "Julian Day",
    y = "Predicted bat occurrences",
    color = "Light color"
  ) + 
  theme_classic()

ggplot(pred, aes(x=x, y=group, fill=predicted)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    x = "Julian Day",
    y = "Light color",
    fill = 'Predicted occurrences'
  ) +
  theme_classic()

pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred)

p1 <- ggplot(pred_df, aes(x=x, y=predicted, color=group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  labs(
    x = 'Julian Day',
    y = 'Predicted bat occurrences',
    color = 'Light color',
    fill = 'Light color'
  ) +
  theme_classic()

effect_df <- pred_df %>%
  select(x, predicted, group, facet) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = predicted
  ) %>%
  mutate(effect = W-R)

p2 <- ggplot(effect_df, aes(x = x, y = effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  labs(
    x = "Julian Day",
    y = 'Effect of White Light (White - Red)'
  ) + 
  theme_classic()

library(patchwork)
p1 / p2

ggplot(data_env, aes(x=jd, y=detections, color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'loess') +
  facet_wrap(~ intensity) +
  theme_classic()

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = paste(color, intensity, sep='_')
  )

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(x = treatment, y = detections)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic()

summary_df <- data_env %>%
  group_by(color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_occ = mean(detections),
    se = sd(detections)/sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = factor(intensity), 
                       y = mean_occ,
                       color = color,
                       group=color)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_occ -se,
        ymax = mean_occ +se),
        width = 0.1
  ) +
    theme_classic()

ggplot(data_env, aes(color, detections)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(
    x = "Light color",
    y = "Bat count"
  )

ggplot(data_env, aes(intensity, detections, color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  labs(
    x = "Light intensity",
    y = "Bat count"
  )

summary_df <- data_env %>%
  group_by(color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(detections, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(detections, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(intensity, mean_count, color = color, group = color))+
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_count - se,
      ymax = mean_count + se
    ),
    width = 0.1
  )
```

```{r}
source("05_data_exploration.R")
source("04_Occurrence_Thresholds.R")

occurrences <- run_thresholds(data_env, thresholds = c(30, 60, 120, 300))

env_data <- data_env %>%
  distinct(
    site,
    date,
    mean_moonlight,
    mean_phase,
    color,
    intensity,
    year,
    jd,
    pct_forest
  )

occurrences <- occurrences %>%
  left_join(
    env_data,
    by = c('site', 'date')
  )

glimpse(occurrences)

occurrences %>%
  ggplot(aes(threshold_sec, occurrences, group = site, color = site)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3)

occurrences %>%
  group_by(threshold_sec) %>%
  summarise(total_occurrences = sum(occurrences))

data_30 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 30)

data_60 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 60)

data_120 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 120)

data_300 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 300)

site_env <- data_env %>%
  distinct(site, pct_forest)

occurrences <- occurrences %>%
  left_join(site_env, by = "site")
```

```{r}

data_30_model <- glmmTMB(
    occurrences ~
      color *
      intensity *
      mean_phase +
      pct_forest +
      jd +
      jd^2 +
      mean_moonlight +
      (1|site) +
      (1|year),
    data = data_30,
    family = nbinom2()
)

data_60_model <- glmmTMB(
    occurrences ~
      color *
      intensity *
      mean_phase +
      pct_forest +
      jd +
      jd^2 +
      mean_moonlight +
      (1|site) +

)

data_120_model <- glmmTMB(

data_300_model <- glmmTMB(
    occurrences ~

      intensity *
      mean_phase +

      jd^2 +

)
```
